channel.title: Jost Neumann – Writing
channel.description: Notes on tourism, investment, development and open data. Content and opinions are personal.

item.title: Open data in a new era: building evidence for rural tourism
item.description: International organizations have published open data for years, at great effort. Building evidence repositories and a visualization platform for rural tourism showed how machine intelligence changes that work, and why human verification remains critical.

item.title: Tourism as a tool for development
item.description: Tourism earns income in places where few other sectors do. Whether that income leads to development depends on how much of it stays local and who takes the decisions.

item.title: Grants as a tool to de-risk investment
item.description: A grant designed with investment in mind can take on the early risks that keep private capital away from small enterprises, and prepare them for finance that has to be repaid.
